sentences.en: His last recourse will be to go to his father for help.
sentences.zh: 他的最后求助对象将是他的父亲。

sentences.en: They had no other recourse but to apologize.
sentences.zh: 他们唯一的办法就是道歉。

sentences.en: He was the only recourse for his family after his father's death.
sentences.zh: 在他父亲去世后，他是家里唯一可以依靠的人。

senses.zh: 求援,追索权,依赖,所依靠的物人

mnemonic: 词根记忆：re（回）+cours（跑）+e→跑回来→求助
